protocol.attemptTiming: Includes initial page navigation, runtime, and independent fixture verification; excludes context setup and browser launch.
protocol.selectionPolicy: Deterministic exact goal/context matching plus declared creative-studio-work → Studio shelf semantic oracle; identical policy in both modes.
protocol.scope: Local neutral fixtures; measures executor behavior only. No general website or model-latency claim.

runtime.scope: General native/ARIA search and exact-link opening subset; independent task verification is external. Navigation and fetch/XHR stay within the start origin; HTTP(S) GET/HEAD static subresources may use other origins. All non-read methods and downloads are blocked.
runtime.metricScope: explicitProtocolCalls counts only explicit runtime Playwright calls, including handle disposal and route setup; it excludes Playwright internal traffic and chooser screenshots/provider calls. Observation time includes browser-side waits; conditionWaitMs overlaps it. Total excludes initial page navigation.
